book.name: 1 Kolinita
book.title: 1 KOLINITA MeKolinita ꞌidi leta ꞌaigeda Paulo ꞌileleya

content: Cilobwainegomiya ma ꞌigu mumuga bewa waheꞌauꞌaunaowe, gide taugu Keliso mumugana yaheheꞌauꞌaunaoweya.
Wahiwahine ꞌidi pasa tapwalolo ꞌoina
Yauwedo ꞌiyagwao, weyahina heꞌitaowedi yaꞌebwae pwaigomiya wanuwatuhu yahidiya ma waꞌabiyahidi.
Nuwanuwagu ma wasanapu ꞌabehega Keliso loheloheya ꞌida Bada, ma hesi wahiwahine ꞌidi badao beno mwanediyao. Ta Keliso ꞌina Bada Yehoba.
Ceguma loheya debana maꞌana hewanu ꞌiꞌahwaꞌahwanoi bo ꞌipalopisai Yehoba ꞌina nuwatuhuwega, beno ꞌebe debamwadina ꞌina Bada Keliso ꞌoina.

Ma ꞌeguma wahine deba daisinamo tapwalolo ꞌoina ꞌiꞌahwaꞌahwanoi bo ꞌipalopisai, beno ꞌebe debamwadina ꞌina badaina, tauna mwanena, ꞌoina. Moisa tuwa, ꞌana ꞌita galana, gide ꞌeguma debana mabwaiyana sinoꞌi.
Weyahina ꞌeguma wahine sahena debana ꞌiꞌahuꞌahusam debana waꞌupwa, ma ꞌimwadina debana noꞌinoꞌina weyahina, ꞌoinega ꞌida ꞌahusam ta ꞌana ꞌita ꞌibwebweꞌana tapwalolo ꞌoina.

Tapwalolo ꞌalona loheya geya sawasawahina debana ꞌiꞌahusam, weyahina loheya ꞌana ꞌita Yehoba gidemusa, ta wete ꞌana hepwatu Yehoba ꞌana hepwatu gidemusa. Wahine wete ꞌana hepwatu loheya ꞌana hepwatu gidemusa.
Ma loheya nugenugetaina geya wahine ꞌoinega ꞌihapwesama, ma hesi wahine loheya ꞌoinega ꞌihapwesama.
Wete Yehoba loheya ꞌihemasaleheya geya wahine weyahina, ma hesi wahine loheya weyahina ꞌihemasaleheya.
Coinega wahiwahine ꞌilobwainediya ma debadi sisamudi tapwalolo ꞌana tuta ꞌoina, ma wahiwahineyedi ꞌidi hematamatana mwanediyao ꞌoidiya aneloseyao siꞌita.
Ma hesi ꞌeguma Bada ꞌina ꞌeda tamulimuliye geya sawasawahina ma wahine ꞌiboi ꞌiloiloina. Wete gesowana loheya ꞌiboi ꞌiloiloina.
Weyahina wahine loheya ꞌoinega ꞌilatuwa ta loheya wahine ꞌoinega ꞌiliꞌuwa, ta mabwaiyada Yehoba ꞌoinega talatuwa.
Wanuwatuhuyahi, ꞌeguma wahine debadaisinamo ꞌiꞌahwaꞌahwanoi Yehoba ꞌoina, togidega ꞌana ꞌita bwebweꞌana bo galana? Galana ꞌawa?
Mabwaiyada baleꞌuwa tamiyamiya, ꞌeguma loheya taꞌita debana dudulena, ꞌana ꞌita wahine gidemusa, beno ꞌebe debamwadina,
ma ꞌeguma wahiwahine debadi dudulena beno ꞌadi ꞌebe hepwatu ma wete ꞌana ꞌebe ꞌahusam.
Cada loina bewa gide, ma geya ꞌeta wete hali loina tohekalesiyao mabwaiyada ꞌoida, ꞌoinega sahena ꞌeta taiya loinaina weyahina ꞌigwaegwae hila.
Bada ꞌina Cai Heꞌasisi
Caigeda wete mumugami weyahina geya yada yaliyaya, beno geya bwebweꞌana.
Weyahina tupwana tomota sihegwaegauwa ꞌabehega ꞌimi ꞌetoꞌauta ꞌoidiya wawatawatahigomi hali boda ma hali boda ꞌoidiyega, ma tupwana ꞌidi gwae yahemisaeya.
Ta hesi ꞌimi ꞌewatawatahaina ꞌana bwebweꞌana beno ꞌabehega taiyewedi taudi tohekalesiyao moisa taꞌinanadi.
Ma wete ꞌimi ꞌetoꞌauta ꞌoidiya ꞌeguma ꞌida Badaina ꞌina Cai Heꞌasisi waꞌai, ꞌana ꞌita geya bwebweꞌana.
Weyahina tupwami waboi ꞌamiwa waꞌaiꞌai, ma tupwadi ꞌiyamiyao maꞌadi gomale, ta wete tupwami waꞌaiꞌai ma wanumanuma hedada ꞌoinega waheheyauyaule.

Cilobwainegomiya ma waboi ꞌimi hada ꞌoidiya waꞌai ma wanuma ta sahena Yehoba ꞌina tapwalolo waꞌabiꞌabi hegala ma wete taudi wewewewelohedi waꞌabiꞌabihe debamwadinedi. Bewa weyahina gesowana yahehepwatuwegomi.
Cida Bada Yesu ꞌina ꞌai ꞌana sanapu ꞌiheꞌita pwaigauwa ta taugu yaheꞌitegomi, beno nihuwanaina ꞌoina Yudasa ꞌitebaeya, Yesuina beledi ꞌiꞌeweya,
ta ꞌiloyauwedowa Yehoba ꞌoina ma ꞌihisiya, ta ꞌigwaeya “Bewa wahigu ꞌomi ꞌami ꞌabihetena weyahina. Coinega bewa gide ꞌagu ꞌebe nuwatuhuyahina wapaihowa ꞌese.”

Siꞌaiya ꞌigumwala, ma biyo wete Yesu ꞌiꞌeweya ta ꞌigwaeya, “Biyo bewa loina ꞌehauna weyahina, ma loinaina hauhauna bweyahiguwega yaꞌabihe latuheyama. Ceguma ꞌabwa to tuta ꞌoidiya wanuma wanuwatuhu yahigau.”
Belediina ꞌana ꞌai ma biyoina ꞌana numa ꞌoidiyega Badaina ꞌina ꞌamasa weyahina taheheꞌita tuta mabwaiyana ma ꞌana siga ꞌihilama.
Ma hesi ꞌeguma taiya ꞌeꞌahaiina ꞌiꞌai besobeso, nuwana Badaina ꞌina biyoina ꞌoinega ꞌinuma besobeso, loheyaina beno ꞌina pui, weyahina ꞌida Bada wahina ma bweyahina ꞌoidiya ꞌipaihowa besobesoweya.
Ceguma nuwanuwada ma Bada ꞌina ꞌai taꞌai, nugeta mumugada weyahina tanuwatuhu, ma wete tada ꞌabihe dumwalugita, ma muliyetega ꞌeꞌahaiina taꞌai, ma wete biyoina ꞌoinega tanuma.
Weyahina ꞌeguma taiya ꞌiꞌai besobeso nuwana ꞌinuma besobeso, ma geya ꞌinuwatuhu Keliso wahina weyahina, ꞌabwa ꞌana loina ꞌiloba.
Bewa lamuna ꞌoinega ꞌami lohala ta ꞌimi weꞌao tupwana baibaiwana silatulatu ꞌoimiya, ma wete tupwana ꞌami boda siꞌamasa pwaiya.
Cilobwainegita ma mumugada tauda taꞌabihe bwebweꞌanedi tabu ta Yehoba ꞌiloinaegita.
Ma hesi ꞌeguma tuta bewa ꞌoina Yehoba ꞌiloinaegita, beno ꞌiꞌabiꞌabihe dumwaluwegita, ma ꞌabwa bwaꞌomatana ꞌoina mebaleꞌu ꞌiloinaedi ma tauda geya.
Ciyagwao, ꞌeguma tutaina Bada ꞌina ꞌai waꞌai, ꞌiyamiyao wayamwadi.

Ma ꞌeguma taiya ꞌigomale, ꞌina hada nobwa ꞌiꞌai nugeta, ta ꞌoinega gesowana ꞌiꞌaiꞌai hedade tapwalolo ꞌalona, tabu ma Yehoba ꞌigamwasowalegomi ꞌimi tapwalolo ꞌana ꞌita galana weyahina. Beno tuwa, loinaina weyahina. Ma hesi tupwana ꞌami loina wete simiyamiya. Ceguma tutaina yanaowa loinaedi wete yaꞌabihe dumwaludi ꞌoimiya.
